meta.name: workers-best-practices
meta.description: Cloudflare Workers best practices for production applications. Use when writing, reviewing, or configuring Workers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按生产环境标准检视和编写云上代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用 Workers 做线上业务,需要避开常见坑。
copy.tagline_en: Review and write production-ready edge applications.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run production services on edge runtimes and want solid conventions.

howto.what: 编写、审查或配置 Cloudflare Workers 时,Claude 会先检索 Cloudflare 文档而不是凭记忆,以项目已安装版本、生成的类型和 Wrangler 兼容性设置为基线,并对照反模式清单标记问题。
howto.when: 触发时机是任务涉及编写、审查或配置 Cloudflare Workers 时。

say.text: 按 Workers 最佳实践帮我审查这段代码。
say.note: Claude 会对照反模式清单逐项检查。

say.text: 这个 Worker 上线前要开启日志和追踪,帮我补上配置。
say.note: Claude 会开启日志与追踪相关设置。

say.text: 这里用 Math.random() 生成令牌安全吗?
say.note: Claude 会说明风险并建议改用 crypto 随机数。

howto.what_en: When writing, reviewing, or configuring Workers, Claude fetches Cloudflare docs instead of relying on memory. It flags code against anti-patterns, using installed versions, generated types, and compatibility settings as the baseline.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the task involves writing, reviewing, or configuring Cloudflare Workers.

say_en.text: Review this Workers code against best practices.
say_en.note: Claude checks it against the anti-pattern list.

say_en.text: Set up logs and traces for this Worker before it goes live.
say_en.note: Claude will enable the log and trace settings.

say_en.text: Is it safe to generate tokens here with Math.random()?
say_en.note: Claude explains the risk and suggests crypto randomness.
